description: Where an alternative's own tag term and the definition's `%tags` join, the alternative's own term runs first. Here it is an error of the grammar, tag(""), and `%tags` asks a query about its own rule and span, which would be another error. The result is the first one, an error of the grammar (engine §4, §3.7).
grammar:
%rule text A x
%rule x B <tag(text(tail($)))>
%tags
  tags($, x)
